"""Parser for Meridian CRM audited-column configuration files."""

from collections import defaultdict


def audited_columns(cfg_text: str) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    """Return audited columns grouped by table from an audit_config.cfg string.

    Blank lines and lines whose first non-whitespace character is ``#`` are
    ignored. All other lines must have the form ``AUDIT <TABLE> <COLUMN>``.
    """
    columns_by_table: defaultdict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)

    for line_number, line in enumerate(cfg_text.splitlines(), start=1):
        stripped = line.strip()

        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue

        tokens = stripped.split()
        if len(tokens) != 3 or tokens[0] != "AUDIT":
            raise ValueError(
                f"Invalid audit configuration line {line_number}: {line!r}"
            )

        _, table, column = tokens
        columns_by_table[table].add(column)

    return dict(columns_by_table)
